environment_caveats: Audited the Cloudflare Pages staging preview, not the apex. clients/quality-contracting-inc.json has no apex_cutover.completed_at, and https://qualitycontracting.us/ still serves the client's old WordPress site (Kinsta origin, title 'Home - Quality Contracting, Inc.', /92370eb0990e4d9a832d8b93a4bd94ef.txt returns 404).

GET https://staging.rankai-quality-contracting-inc.pages.dev/ returns x-robots-tag: noindex, injected automatically by Cloudflare Pages on *.pages.dev. The Lighthouse is-crawlable audit fails on all 6 URLs as a result and deflates the SEO category to 69. SEO is inconclusive this run and was excluded from every verdict. Verdicts were computed from performance, accessibility and best_practices only.

Canonical tags on all 6 pages point to https://qualitycontracting.us/... rather than the staging URL, so the DataForSEO 'canonical' self-reference check reports false on all 6. That is correct behaviour for a staging preview and is not recorded as an issue.

Lighthouse 13.4.0 ran desktop only (formFactor desktop, cpuSlowdownMultiplier 1, throughputKbps 10240). Mobile scores would typically run 10-20 performance points lower, and the homepage CLS finding would very likely be worse on mobile.

clients/quality-contracting-inc.json has status 'onboarding' rather than 'active'. The audit proceeded because build_status is 'pushed_main' and the staging origin serves 200 on all 6 URLs. This matches prior practice on prorestoration (status 'pending') and mcc-restoration.
